summary: Valneva SE filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, attaching a press release dated October 14, 2026, announcing that senior management will present and host investor meetings at four healthcare conferences between October 15 and November 16, 2026, in Paris, Boston, New York, and London. Discussions will center on key value drivers and upcoming catalysts, primarily the regulatory outlook for the Lyme disease vaccine candidate partnered with Pfizer, with decisions expected within 12 months, plus R&D pipeline progress. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is involved; this is a routine investor-relations scheduling notice.
